tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window background and the ground of Settings-style content.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Grouped boxes, cards and list groups one step above `bg`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells below `bg`: code blocks, empty areas.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Opaque menus, popovers and dialogs.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Quiet Control backgrounds: secondary buttons, segmented controls, search fields. Translucent, so it takes the colour beneath.

tokens.name: fill-strong
tokens.usage: `fill` under the pointer or pressed; toggle tracks when off.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a Control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: The visible boundary of a Control that has no fill of its own (text field, checkbox); holds 3:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body copy and titles on every ground, surface, fill and material fallback.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text, labels and metadata on every ground.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholders, hints and timestamps; still 4.5:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Text of disabled Controls only. Exempt from contrast by WCAG; never for content.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Fills of primary buttons, selected sidebar rows, switches when on. Carries `on-accent` text.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: `accent` fill under the pointer.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: `accent` fill while pressed.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet accent background: a selected row in a list that is not focused.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent`, `accent-hover` and `accent-pressed`.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and accent-coloured text on every ground.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success: text and icons on every ground and on `success-subtle`. Always paired with a word or icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of a success message; carries `success` text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings, such as Caps Lock is on: text and icons on every ground and on `warning-subtle`. Always paired with a word or icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of a warning message; carries `warning` text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions, such as a wrong password: text and icons on every ground and on `danger-subtle`. Always paired with a word or icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of a danger message; carries `danger` text.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information: text and icons on every ground and on `info-subtle`. Always paired with a word or icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of a info message; carries `info` text.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, drawn `focus-ring-offset` outside the focused element; 3:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims everything behind a modal dialog or sheet.

tokens.name: wallpaper-1
tokens.usage: Top-left of the default wallpaper gradient. The Greeter and scenes draw it as a diagonal gradient through stops 1 to 3.

tokens.name: wallpaper-2
tokens.usage: Middle of the default wallpaper gradient. The Greeter and scenes draw it as a diagonal gradient through stops 1 to 3.

tokens.name: wallpaper-3
tokens.usage: Bottom-right of the default wallpaper gradient. The Greeter and scenes draw it as a diagonal gradient through stops 1 to 3.

tokens.name: material-panel-tint
tokens.usage: Shell panels and docks: tint over a background blurred by `material-panel-blur`. Needs a compositor blur; without one use `material-panel-fallback`.

tokens.name: material-panel-fallback
tokens.usage: Shell panels and docks: the solid colour where no blur is available (the Greeter in Cage). Every text Token holds contrast on it.

tokens.name: material-popover-tint
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and the Greeter's login card: tint over a background blurred by `material-popover-blur`. Needs a compositor blur; without one use `material-popover-fallback`.

tokens.name: material-popover-fallback
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and the Greeter's login card: the solid colour where no blur is available (the Greeter in Cage). Every text Token holds contrast on it.

tokens.name: material-sidebar-tint
tokens.usage: App sidebars: tint over a background blurred by `material-sidebar-blur`. Needs a compositor blur; without one use `material-sidebar-fallback`.

tokens.name: material-sidebar-fallback
tokens.usage: App sidebars: the solid colour where no blur is available (the Greeter in Cage). Every text Token holds contrast on it.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Helper text under a setting, metadata.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text everywhere: rows, labels, buttons.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: Button labels, sidebar rows, status messages.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Window and page titles in the toolbar.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Dialog titles, the date on the Greeter.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Large clocks: the Greeter and the lock screen. Tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a Control; between rows in a sidebar.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between related Controls; row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding inside grouped boxes.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of popovers and the login card.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between groups in a window.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Padding of dialogs and window content.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large layout gaps.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Screen-level margins.

tokens.name: radius-small
tokens.usage: Small parts inside a Control: segmented-control segments, pop-up buttons, sidebar icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, sidebar rows, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Grouped boxes, cards, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Windows, dialogs, Shell panels, the login card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, toggles, the password field, avatars as circles.

size.note: Fixed heights that keep Controls compact.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Regular buttons, pop-up buttons, text fields.

tokens.name: control-height-small
tokens.usage: Small buttons and fields in dense rows and toolbars.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Sidebar rows and menu items.

tokens.name: control-height-large
tokens.usage: Prominent single fields, such as the Greeter's password field.

tokens.name: row-height-large
tokens.usage: Rows in grouped Settings boxes.

tokens.name: toolbar-height
tokens.usage: Window toolbars holding the title.

tokens.name: avatar-size-large
tokens.usage: The selected user's avatar on the Greeter.

shadow.note: Few levels on purpose: each shadow is an extra render pass.

tokens.name: shadow-resting
tokens.usage: Grouped boxes and cards on `bg`.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Buttons with a fill, the dock, a switch knob.

tokens.name: shadow-floating
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the Greeter's login card.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Windows and dialogs.

material.note: Blur radius of each translucent material. Shown only where the compositor can blur; otherwise the fallback colour is used.

tokens.name: material-panel-blur
tokens.usage: Behind `material-panel-tint`. Compositor effect.

tokens.name: material-popover-blur
tokens.usage: Behind `material-popover-tint`. Compositor effect.

tokens.name: material-sidebar-blur
tokens.usage: Behind `material-sidebar-tint`. Compositor effect.

tokens.name: material-saturation
tokens.usage: Saturation boost of the blurred background behind every material, so colour glows through. Compositor effect.

wallpaper.note: Geometry of the default wallpaper gradient; its colours are the wallpaper-1 to wallpaper-3 colour Tokens.

tokens.name: wallpaper-angle
tokens.usage: Direction of the gradient: top-left to bottom-right.

tokens.name: wallpaper-mid-stop
tokens.usage: Position of `wallpaper-2` along the gradient.

tokens.name: focus-ring-width
tokens.usage: Stroke of the `focus-ring`.

tokens.name: focus-ring-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between the element and its `focus-ring`.

tokens.name: motion-duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press feedback.

tokens.name: motion-duration-normal
tokens.usage: Most transitions: menus opening, state changes.

tokens.name: motion-duration-slow
tokens.usage: Larger moves: panels, dialogs, the Greeter fading into a Session.

tokens.name: motion-easing-standard
tokens.usage: Things that move within the screen.

tokens.name: motion-easing-in
tokens.usage: Things leaving the screen.

tokens.name: motion-easing-out
tokens.usage: Things arriving on the screen.

tokens.name: motion-easing-spring
tokens.usage: Small physical feedback with a gentle overshoot, such as the wrong-password shake.
